clips.send: Split the square into a 6 by 6 grid. There are 36 equal squares. Each has area 72 divided by 36 equals 2.
clips.text: Split the square into a 6 by 6 grid. There are 36 equal squares. Each has area 72 ÷ 36 = 2.

clips.send: The area is 72, so each side has length the square root of 72.
clips.text: The area is 72, so each side has length √72.

clips.send: If the radicand is a perfect square, you can find the exact root. Otherwise, find the two neighboring perfect squares around it. Their roots give the two nearest integer bounds. Zoom to tenths and square those tick values to narrow the interval.
clips.text: If the radicand is a perfect square, you can find the exact root. Otherwise, find the two neighboring perfect squares around it. Their roots give the two nearest integer bounds. Zoom to tenths and square those tick values to narrow the interval.

clips.send: In simplest radical form, there is no denominator inside the radical and no square factor left to take out. For a positive integer radicand, check for perfect-square factors greater than 1. For example, 3 the square root of 8 simplifies to 6 the square root of 2. If the radicand is a perfect square, write the whole-number result, as in the square root of 49 equals 7.
clips.text: In simplest radical form, there is no denominator inside the radical and no square factor left to take out. For a positive integer radicand, check for perfect-square factors greater than 1. For example, 3√8 simplifies to 6√2. If the radicand is a perfect square, write the whole-number result, as in √49 = 7.

clips.send: In the real numbers, an expression of the form the square root of a, with a is greater than or equal to 0, is a square-root expression. The symbol the square root of a means the principal square root of a, the nonnegative number whose square is a. The expression a under the radical sign is the radicand.
clips.text: In the real numbers, an expression of the form √a, with a ≥ 0, is a square-root expression. The symbol √a means the principal square root of a, the nonnegative number whose square is a. The expression a under the radical sign is the radicand.

clips.send: Enter a whole number and test a perfect-square divisor. For example, 72 divided by 36 equals 2. Divide the square of area 72 into six rows and six columns. Each small square has area 2. Count along an edge to see the length of the big square.
clips.text: Enter a whole number and test a perfect-square divisor. For example, 72 ÷ 36 = 2. Divide the square of area 72 into six rows and six columns. Each small square has area 2. Count along an edge to see the length of the big square.

clips.send: Lift out a copy of the bottom row. Its six lengths of the square root of 2 add to 6 the square root of 2, so the square root of 72 equals 6 the square root of 2.
clips.text: Lift out a copy of the bottom row. Its six lengths of √2 add to 6√2, so √72 = 6√2.

clips.send: For addition and subtraction, simplify first, then combine terms with the same radicand. For multiplication and division, combine radicands under one root when the conditions below are met.

clips.send: 正方形的面积为 72，所以每条边长为 根号 72。
clips.text: 正方形的面积为 72，所以每条边长为 √72。

clips.send: 输入一个整数，再选一个完全平方数作除数。比如，72 除以 36 等于 2。把面积为 72 的正方形分成 6 行 6 列，每个小正方形的面积就是 2。沿着一条边数一数，就能看出大正方形的边长。

clips.send: 如果被开方数是完全平方数，就能直接求出它的算术平方根。否则，先找出它介于哪两个相邻的完全平方数之间，再开平方得到两个相邻的整数。把这段数轴细分到十分位，比较刻度值的平方，就能缩小范围。

clips.send: 加减时先化简，再合并被开方数相同的项。乘除时，在满足公式条件的前提下，可以先把被开方数合到同一个根号里。

clips.send: 在实数范围内，当 a 大于等于 0 时， 根号 a 这样的式子叫作二次根式 gēnshì。 根号 a 表示 a 的算术平方根，也就是平方等于 a 的那个非负数。根号内的 a 叫作被开方数。

clips.text: 把最下面一行复制到右边。6 段长度为 √2 的线段接起来，得到 6√2，所以 √72 = 6√2。

clips.send: 最简二次根式的被开方数不含分母，也不含能开得尽方的因数或因式。对于正整数，只要检查被开方数是否还有大于 1 的完全平方因数。例如，3 根号 8 还可化为 6 根号 2。若根号下的数能开得尽方，就直接写成整数，例如 根号 49 等于 7。
